title: HTTP Server & Routing
description: Build a basic HTTP server with multiple routes and understand the Event Loop, libuv and non-blocking I/O.
objective: Create an HTTP server and route requests to different responses.
theory: Node.js uses an event-driven, non-blocking architecture. The Event Loop coordinates asynchronous work while libuv provides the underlying asynchronous I/O mechanisms.
steps: Study Event Loop and libuv concepts
